test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence.**

It is a bad habit to __talk in__ while someone is speaking.
solution:
The correct answer is "**cut in**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the **given phrasal verbs**. ** **

 
 
• **cut in**: to interrupt what someone is saying by saying something yourself. (किसी की बात को स्वयं कुछ कह कर बाधित करना।&
